description: Logan Wolf's tamer, pets, teams and the perk numbers of the Taming Bestiary and the Healer's Codex (harness/sim/pets.py, docs/SIM.md 'Pets, teams and perks'). The perks he has taken, the codex tiers and the pets' Guide values are the scan's: logan_wolf_observed.json (harness/sim/tamer_scan.py).

tamer.note: skills: docs/NOTES.md (Taming, Lore, Veterinary and Herding 120); the searing imp's Guide Details page reads '+22.9 % Damage, +11.4 % Wrestling, +11.4 % Damage Resistance' = 0.4 / 0.2 x (120 - 80) / 70 (the underdog bonus over its min taming); follower_damage: the Mastery Chain's Follower Damage +16 % (docs/NOTES.md); max_slots: the five control slots every live team filled

gravebug.note: Guide (GraveRobber) and its Abilities page; Devour 'Can consume nearby corpses to heal 10% of maximum health', its 15 s cooldown measured live ('*devours corpse*' 15.0-15.2 s apart at the shortest, 3 captures 2026-10-12/13), then '+N' three times 0.5 s apart; Disease (knowledge #14471, tamed 15 %)

phoenix.note: Guide (AlaFlambe) Abilities page and wiki #4255/#4258/#4259/#4271; Epic Barrage reaches 12 tiles (patch 2022-03-16); its cooldown [INFERENCE: Devour's measured 15 s]

nightmare.note: Guide (NightmareA/B) Abilities page; Spellburn as the phoenix's (wiki #4255)

searing imp.note: Guide (a searing imp); its Details page: 'Zoology +4.2 % Damage, +2.1 % DR' (the only Details page captured: the other species' zoology is 0 here)

earth dragon.note: Guide (GirthyEarthy) Abilities page; Earth Breath physical; cooldowns [INFERENCE: Devour's measured 15 s; Earth Shield's equal to its 60 s]

tidal mantis.note: Guide (a tidal mantis) Abilities page; Bleed's ticks every 3 s for 15 s [INFERENCE: the simulator's bleed cadence]; Soak cripples the target's damage by 3 % a control slot

pets_note: serials: the capture's (tidal_tomb_observed pets.*.serials; 0x000DDEFE GraveRobber ... 0x004F3A5A the mantis)

phoenix_gravebug.note: live 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-24 (the Mausoleum's calibration and Tidal Tomb levels 1-2)

teams_note: the tank first, then the pets in the order the simulator always placed them (beside Logan east, south, west, north, south-east)
class_threat_note: the fitted gravebug (4.0) and phoenix (0.1) values the Mausoleum calibrated (of the monsters' attributed hits on 41 live visits the gravebug took 81 %, the phoenix 9.6 %, Logan 9.4 %): the Tank class draws aggro (knowledge #2074); a utility pet as an attack pet [INFERENCE]
hit_chance_note: a melee pet's base chance to hit: the gravebug's measured (n=175 attributed hits); the Bestiary's accuracy perks add to it
move_note: every pet's one-tile moves out of war mode 0.209-0.214 s apart live (tidal_tomb_observed pets.*.step_interval_s_not_fighting); follow 1 and leash 14 as the gravebug and phoenix always had
spell_range_note: the phoenix's range 10 [INFERENCE], for every caster

damage.note: tidal_tomb_observed pets.GraveRobber.damage_dealt_attributed (median 91, n=198) in Tidal Tomb levels 1-2, where it fought; target_ar: the mean wiki armor over those levels' spawns (x < 7049, n=120). pets.k_dmg is this median over the model's (its melee hits on that armor in the reference tank context): one factor for every pet (the unknown stacking is the tamer's, not the species')

AlaFlambe.note: run.py's default-team batch (98 runs, seed 17, 14 careers, --vet-range 5) went from 130.3 to 184.9 kills an hour with the shared k_dmg alone (+42 %, the plan's 15 % limit): the phoenix's model numbers came to 559 a number, 727 a cast every 1.59 s plus Epic Barrage, against the hand-calibrated spec's (211, 776, 327), 438 a cast every 1.8 s. Its own factor: its model mean per number (spells and Spellburn, Spellsurge carried from cast to cast, REF_CASTER, on the Mausoleum spawns' mean magic resist 70.7 and armor 26.0) equal to that 438 (pets.k_override)

anchors.speed_note: tidal_tomb_observed pets.*.attack_animation (2026-10-24/25): the period between attack animations, p10 for the melee pets (their median holds the walks between targets), the median for the casters; action: the 0x6E action of the attack (a caster's cast_action). pets.k_speed per pet is this period over the Guide's attack speed at its level and Command tier 14

Cornered.rule: hurt by a creature within 10 s: dmg_cond, else dmg (the gump's 4/20/25 verbatim)

Feed.rule: a species with Bleed: its target bleeding, dmg_cond and a melee hit heals heal x max hits; a species without: dmg

Giant Killer.rule: melee hit chance + hit, doubled while the result is below 0.66

Hunting Party.rule: the pet and Logan both within 2 of the target: dmg_cond, else dmg

Immolate.rule: a species with Spellburn: its Spellburn + spellburn; else dmg

Lethality.rule: each number: chance of +100 %, else + dmg

Menagerie.rule: dmg_per and heal_per x the team's distinct species

Mutation.rule: a species with a cooldown ability: its cooldowns - cooldown_s (at least 1 s); else dmg

Pelt.rule: the target 4+ tiles off: dmg_cond, else dmg

Primal.rule: a species with a passive ability: its chance x (1 + passive); else dmg

Swarm.rule: dmg_per and heal_per x the team's pets (ghosts count)

Beast Sting.rule: its target poisoned: dmg_cond, else dmg (no species here poisons)

Breaker.rule: physical hits ignore ar of the target's armor (at most 75 in all), spells mr of its magic resist (at most 150)

Carrion.rule: a species with Disease: its target diseased, dmg_cond and a melee hit heals heal x max hits; else dmg

Contagion.rule: a species with Disease: its ticks + tick; else dmg

Dominance.rule: melee hit chance + hit until 5 hits on that target, re-armed 15 s after its first

Metabolism.rule: a melee hit heals heal x max hits; at max hits dmg_cond

Scour.rule: a species with Soak: its cripple x (1 + cripple); else dmg

Swoop.rule: a species with a cooldown ability: its next attack within 10 s of a cooldown use + swoop; else dmg

Toxic.rule: a species with Disease: this chance its first tick lands twice at once; else dmg

Adrenaline.rule: within 15 s of a resurrection: dmg_cond and dr_cond, else dmg and dr

Aggression.rule: n distinct creatures that hurt it within 10 s (at most 3): dmg_per and dr_per x n; none: dmg

Alpha.rule: melee hit chance + hit, doubled when its target is on it

Behemoth.rule: 3+ control slots: dmg_cond and dr_cond, else dmg and dr

Critical Care.rule: resurrection chance x (1 + res_chance); it comes back with + res_hits of its max hits

Deflection.rule: dr against no attacker or one not on it; dr_cond against one on it

Guardians.rule: 2+ live tank-class pets: dr_cond, else dr

Mending.rule: heals on it + heal; at max hits and not poisoned dmg_cond

Stalwart.rule: dr (its debuff-ignore has nothing to act on here)

Tolerance.rule: this chance a bleed, disease or poison tick on it is skipped; not afflicted: dr

Trample.rule: a melee hit: damage_max x trample on up to 2 other monsters within 2 of the target; a caster: dmg

perks.bestiary_note: per rank 1/2/3 (1, 3 and 5 points); the gump's texts (Taming Bestiary, gump 1353229584, sessions 192/194) and wiki #16334-16345. A rule's 'else' is for a species without the mechanic named: here Disease (gravebug), Bleed and Soak (tidal mantis), Spellburn (every caster), cooldown abilities (gravebug, phoenix, earth dragon); none has stealth, frenzy, poison, chill, entangle/hinder, pierce/hex, flamestrike or a multi-target ability. Bonuses add within a pool; the pools multiply [INFERENCE]

Combat Medic.rule: patients dr for 15 s after a finish

Immunize.rule: bleed and disease ticks on patients - tick for 15 s after a finish (poison levels aren't modelled)

Overheal.rule: + heal of each heal, in 3 ticks over the next 3 s

Pressure Points.rule: Logan's melee (he never melees: no effect)

Self Treatment.rule: bandages only, no effect on supplies

Specialist.rule: heals + heal, resurrect/cure chance + chance (of normal)

Triage.rule: patients within reach while a channel runs: dr, doubled below 33 % hits

Without Borders.rule: the supplies' reach + range; heals + heal, resurrect/cure chance + chance

perks.codex_note: per tier 1/2/3 (1, 3 and 5 points); the gump's texts (Healer's Codex, gump 1244441914). The Command aspect's Inspiration special isn't modelled: no live trigger found
